title: Prompt Guard v2.5.0 Update
summary: This update expands Prompt Guard's patterns to block authority impersonation, indirect injection, and multi-turn manipulation, and introduces a stronger defense system.
content:
I made a major update to Prompt Guard for ClaudeBot (now OpenClaw), which I shared yesterday. With advice from a white-hat hacker friend who is among the best in the world, this release expands the attack patterns to 349.

New defenses:
• Authority impersonation detection ("I'm an administrator," "This is a system message")
• Indirect injection blocking (malicious prompts hidden in URLs/files)
• Multi-turn manipulation detection (attacks that build trust over multiple conversations)
• Token smuggling protection (Unicode zero-width character tricks)
• Scenario-based jailbreak blocking ("In a dream...", "For a movie scenario...")
• Emotional manipulation detection ("It's an emergency," "A life is at risk")

Installation and updating take 30 seconds.

# New users
clawdhub install prompt-guard

# Existing users
clawdhub update prompt-guard
